scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
Congratulation! Celebrate Feast Day Of Ramadan Idul Fitri 1427 H.
scripts.translation:
[开斋节职员]
节日快乐！一起庆祝伊斯兰历1427年的开斋节吧！

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
Haii......^FF8800{0}^000000!!
First day of Idul Fitri has arrived.
Congratulation celebrate him.
There is event special today.
scripts.translation:
[开斋节职员]
嗨...^FF8800{0}^000000！！
开斋节的第一天到了，祝你节日快乐！
今天还有特别活动。

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
Event today.....^009500Idul Fitri Quest!^000000
scripts.translation:
[开斋节职员]
今天的活动是...^009500开斋节任务！^000000

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
If you interest to follow this event, I will cook it to you.
scripts.translation:
[开斋节职员]
如果你有兴趣参加，我就为你做一道美食。

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
I have something that might interest you.
I need all of the following items:
^D5A500Ketupat Sayur Ingredient :^000000
^00B6FF~5 Ketupat, 5 Carrot~,^000000
^CC6633~5 Sweet Potato, 10 Meat~,^000000
^000088~2 Green Herb, 5 Stem~.^000000
scripts.translation:
[开斋节职员]
我准备了一样你可能会感兴趣的东西。
需要以下所有材料：
^D5A500蔬菜椰叶粽的材料：^000000
^00B6FF~5个椰叶粽、5根胡萝卜~，^000000
^CC6633~5个红薯、10块肉~，^000000
^000088~2株绿色药草、5根茎~。^000000

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
You don't have enough items.
Come back when you have them all.
scripts.translation:
[开斋节职员]
您的物品不足。
集齐后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
I see you already have all the items you need.
Just a moment, please!!
scripts.translation:
[开斋节职员]
看来您已经集齐了所有需要的物品。
请稍等！！

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
We appreciate your participation in this special event.
scripts.translation:
[开斋节职员]
感谢您参加这个特别活动。

scripts.text:
[Staff Idul Fitri]
Oh well, maybe you will participate in tommorow's quest.
scripts.translation:
[开斋节职员]
好吧，那就明天再来参加任务吧。
